# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue, pull request,
discussion, or commit message. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form:

https://github.com/Hanjay6688/-erp-garment-ux/security/advisories/new

Include the affected commit or version, impact, reproduction steps, and the
smallest safe proof needed to validate the report. Never include live credentials,
personal data, production records, database dumps, or reusable access tokens.

## Supported versions

Before the first stable release, security fixes target `main` and the currently
active release-candidate branch. Historical and archived branches are not
supported unless their changes are being promoted into an active candidate.
